short_description: A seated core exercise that works the abs and hip flexors by drawing the knees in and extending the legs out.
how_to: Sit on the floor with your hands behind your hips for support.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet off the floor.
Draw both knees in toward your chest.
Extend your legs back out straight without touching the floor.
Continue in a steady, controlled rhythm.
correct: Keep your chest up and your torso stable.
Keep your core tight on every rep.
mistakes: Don't let your feet drop to the floor between reps.
Don't rush and lose control of the movement.

short_description: A fundamental ab exercise that contracts the rectus abdominis by curling your upper body toward your knees.
how_to: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your fingertips lightly at the sides of your head.
Exhale and curl your upper back off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower back down with control.
correct: Keep your chin away from your chest.
Relax your neck and let your abs do the work.
Move slowly on the way down.

short_description: A stability exercise that strengthens the lower back, glutes and core by extending opposite arm and leg from a tabletop position.
how_to: Start on all fours with your wrists under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Extend your right arm forward and your left leg back at the same time.
Hold for a moment, then return to the start.
Switch sides and repeat in a slow, controlled alternating pattern.
correct: Keep your hips level throughout the movement.
Keep your back flat, not arched or rounded.
Move with control rather than speed.
Breathe steadily and don't hold your breath.
mistakes: Don't rotate your hips as you extend.
Don't let your lower back sag.
Don't look up; keep your gaze down.
